ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Letter A in the following diagram represents which stage?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of the life history of a jellyfish, including stages such as the adult jellyfish, fertilization/larva, attached polyp, and strobila. The white label A is located in the middle right, close to a purple, star-shaped or small umbrella-shaped, freely swimming juvenile jellyfish form; it is located after the stacked strobila stage at the lower right and before the adult jellyfish stage above. Reasoning: In the life history of jellyfish, the juvenile jellyfish stage released from the strobila and not yet developed into an adult jellyfish is called ephyra. Therefore, the letter A represents the ephyra stage.
